answer_1.quote: Recent progress in text summarization has been supported by the availability of large amounts of supervised data, such as the CNN/Daily Mail and XSum datasets, which provide a single, generic, topic-agnostic summary.
answer_1.outputs: extractive summaries conditioned on aspect-level keywords

answer_2.quote: On ASPECTNEWS, we evaluate our model against the annotations using using F 1 score and ROUGE scores... we also calculate ROUGE-1, -2, and -L scores.

answer_4.quote: We presented the user intents to annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk. An annotator is shown a description of intent from Table along with an article and is asked to identify a few sentences from the article that constitute a summary. They can rate each sentence on a scale from 0 to 3 to account for some sentences being more relevant than others.
answer_4.guideline: Annotator is shown a description of intent and asked to identify sentences that constitute a summary, rating each sentence from 0 to 3 based on relevance.
